integrity: All polynomial counts proved via direct parametrization and finite-field linear algebra; finite verifier replay supports but does not certify universal quantifiers. References identify prior structural results.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime fields and the Heisenberg group of order \(p^3\) only; the displayed matrix-indexed family does not contain every skew brace. Earlier work establishes the structural classification and the brace construction, while exact lift and bijectivity enumerations are the present contribution. Unindexed equivalent enumerations may exist.
title: Rota–Baxter liftability and sharp bijectivity statistics for finite Heisenberg skew braces
